questions.explanation: B = mu0 N I/(2R) = 4pi e-7*150*3/(2*0.06) = 0.01178 T. The tempting error omits N.

questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, an alpha particle (m=6.64e-27 kg, q=3.2e-19 C) moves at 1.0e6 m/s perpendicular to a 0.20 T field; what is the radius?
questions.explanation: r = mv/(qB) = 6.64e-27*1e6/(3.2e-19*0.2) = 0.104 m. The tempting error inverts q and m.

questions.topic: Refraction into a denser medium
questions.learningObjective: Explain refracted ray direction
questions.stem: In an analyst's dashboard note, a ray passes from water to glass, both denser than air; what determines the bend direction?

options.text: The ray reflects completely at the boundary
options.misconception: confuses refraction with total internal reflection

options.text: The ray always bends away from the normal
options.misconception: assumes bending away regardless of media

options.text: The ray never bends between two dense media
The ray bends toward the normal if the second medium is denser

questions.explanation: Refraction bends toward the normal when entering a denser medium. The tempting ideas deny or reverse the bend.
